arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib
payload = pathlib.Path('examples/requests.jsonl').read_bytes()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', str(pathlib.Path('submission/main.py').resolve())], cwd=cwd, input=payload, capture_output=True)
exp = pathlib.Path('examples/expected.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()
got = run.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print(len(exp), len(got))
for i in range(min(len(exp), len(got))):
    e, g = json.loads(exp[i]), json.loads(got[i])
    if e != g:
        print('LINE', i)
        print('exp', json.dumps(e))
        print('got', json.dumps(g))
print(run.stderr.decode()[:500])
EOF
